set -eu
wgid=$(getent group report-writers | cut -d: -f3)
rgid=$(getent group report-readers | cut -d: -f3)
check_root=/srv/reports/.acl-functional-test-$$
trap 'rm -rf "$check_root"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
setpriv --reuid=60001 --regid="$wgid" --clear-groups sh -c 'umask 077; mkdir "$1"; printf "writer-created\n" > "$1/report.txt"; mkdir "$1/subdir"; printf "nested-readable\n" > "$1/subdir/nested.txt"' sh "$check_root"
setpriv --reuid=60003 --regid="$wgid" --clear-groups sh -c 'printf "writer-modified\n" >> "$1/report.txt"; touch "$1/writer-delete-check"; rm "$1/writer-delete-check"' sh "$check_root"
printf 'inherited_directory_acl:\n'; getfacl -cp "$check_root/subdir"

printf 'reader_content='; setpriv --reuid=60002 --regid="$rgid" --clear-groups cat "$check_root/report.txt"

if setpriv --reuid=60002 --regid="$rgid" --clear-groups sh -c 'printf "forbidden\n" >> "$1"' sh "$check_root/report.txt" 2>/dev/null; then printf 'reader_append=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n'; exit 1; else printf 'reader_append=denied\n'; fi

if setpriv --reuid=60002 --regid="$rgid" --clear-groups rm "$check_root/report.txt" 2>/dev/null; then printf 'reader_delete=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n'; exit 1; else printf 'reader_delete=denied\n'; fi
if setpriv --reuid=60004 --regid=65534 --clear-groups cat "$check_root/report.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'unaffiliated_read=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n'; exit 1; else printf 'unaffiliated_read=denied\n'; fi
